text: can u uh add mirror placement for joints so i can place front tires and back tires on the same exact spot proportionally
resolution: Extended the multi-plane mirror to rig joints so a wheel/tire mount placed once gets its symmetric partners, instead of hand-placing each. New pure helpers in editMesh: mirrorMount() reflects a MountPoint's position AND spin axis across a set of planes and suffixes a unique name; addMountReflections() adds a named joint's reflections across every non-empty subset of the enabled planes (X = left/right, X+Z = front-right + rear-left + rear-right from one front-left placement) keeping names unique; updateMountMirrored() moves a joint to a new spot AND its position-matched mirror partners so adjusting one wheel keeps the set symmetric. Studio wiring: a '⇄ mirror joint' button appears in rig mode when a joint is selected and at least one mirror plane (the existing X/Y/Z chip cluster) is enabled — it reflects the selected joint into its partners; commitRig now routes joint drags through updateMountMirrored when planes are on. Verified: editMesh suite 62/62 (4-wheel placement + synced drag), full hmsc-int cart bundles clean. Committed 50cae452a.
